# telnyx_email_inbox (Resource)

An inbox that receives email on an inbound-enabled domain, or on the account's shared inbound subdomain when `domain_id` is not set. The Telnyx API soft-deletes inboxes: after destroy the address stays reserved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_email_inbox" "support" {
  domain_id = telnyx_email_domain.mail.id
  username  = "support"
}

resource "telnyx_email_inbox_sender_filters" "support" {
  inbox_id  = telnyx_email_inbox.support.id
  blocklist = ["spam@example.net"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Account-owned, inbound-enabled domain UUID. The account's shared inbound subdomain is allocated when omitted.
- `username` (String) The local part of the address, before the `@`, in lowercase. Generated when not set.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `domain` (String) Domain name used by the inbox address.
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String)
- `settings` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_email_inbox.example <id>
```
